task: rtl/spi_master.sv is an 8-bit SPI master: all four CPOL/CPHA modes, MSB- or LSB-first (lsb_first), SCLK half-period of `div` clock cycles (div 1..255). SCLK idles at CPOL. cs_n goes low one half-period before the first SCLK edge and returns high one half-period after the last edge, at which point busy drops, done pulses for one cycle and rx holds the received byte. tb/tb_spi_smoke.sv is the block's smoke test. Make it signoff-ready at 4 ns. Keep the port list.
